description: This file is a Gradle build configuration script for an Android application project using Kotlin and Flutter integration. It specifies plugins, Android SDK versions, dependencies, build types, and custom tasks for managing the APK build output.

methods.name: syncDebugApkToFlutterBuildDir
methods.description: Custom Gradle task that copies the Flutter debug APK from the Android build output directory to the Flutter project build directory for preview tooling.
